closure_result.note: the 11-target set is consumer-reachable; the image-wide derivation over all callers also proves EVP_MAC_free, EVP_SKEYMGMT_free and EVP_KEM_free (14 targets)

non_claims: Not an independent review; the author of the rule is the author of the self-test.
The 11-target set is a bound for the ssh/sshd reachable writers, not a link-time bound for all consumers.
No Miri/ASan/Loom run and no Rust test suite: no Rust source changed.
The declared names remain a human cross-check; they are not evidence.

The one-level field follow is by the audited slot offset (EvpMethodData.destruct_method, 0x40), not by object-identity tracking; the correspondence to that object is the audited slot's declaration plus the recorded provenance chain.
Site identification uses the audited EVT-METHOD-FREE function/offset scope; it does not independently type the object at every 0x20 displacement in those functions.
The provenance resolver seeds ABI argument registers symbolically; a function that reads a register it was not passed is treated as a symbolic argument rather than as unknown.
